title: Self-Tor projection homology for the termwise pullback representative
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-self-tor-pushforward-homology, the degree-k homology of the derived tensor square of the pushed-forward structure sheaf is isomorphic to the pushforward of the degree-k homology of the termwise tensor pullback of P.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.22.1, together with Tags 068G and 08KS

proof.text: Apply the arrow-level projection and representative-comparison theorem and package its invertible arrow as an isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_selfTor_projection_homology_termwise
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single Y.Modules (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a)
    (k : ℤ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B)) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T.homology k))
